A '''[[Elom/Legends|Elom]] officer''' served as a [[Fleet Commander/Legends|fleet commander]] for the [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].

==History==
A [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] [[Fleet Commander/Legends|fleet commander]] served alongside the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on the [[escort freighter]] ''[[Nemphas]]'' as ship commander. After [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Gizz's Gang|Gizz's swoop gang]] stole the [[interstellar attack craft]] ''[[Spirit of Jabba]]'' from Gorga. The furious Hutt ordered his [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], [[Ding (majordomo)|Ding]], to summon the commander to catch the thieves. In orbit around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the commander communicated with the crew of the stolen [[Starship/Legends|ship]] requesting surrender. After receiving no response, he instructed the [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] to begin firing on the ship's weapons to avoid damaging the cargo. The fire from Nemphas continued until [[Gizman]] contacted the comms, offering to negotiate. Elom flatly refused to negotiate and ordered the enemy crew to obey during the escort or they would be eliminated. When the stolen ship was over [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], the crew decided to dump the cargo on Gorga's head. Began a short fast for Jabba's Spirit, but it proved unsuccessful.<ref name="TJT" />
